def register_hooks() -> None:
    from hcu_sglang.utils.detection import is_hcu

    if not is_hcu():
        return
    from sglang.srt.layers.attention import index_topk_share as native
    from sglang.srt.plugins.hook_registry import HookRegistry, HookType

    if not hasattr(native, "write_mtp_seed"):
        native.write_mtp_seed = write_mtp_seed
    HookRegistry.register(
        "sglang.srt.layers.attention.index_topk_share.IndexTopKShareState",
        IndexTopKShareState,
        HookType.REPLACE,
    )
    HookRegistry.register(
        "sglang.srt.layers.attention.index_topk_share.write_mtp_seed",
        write_mtp_seed,
        HookType.REPLACE,
    )
